observations.workflow_dispatch_command: gh workflow run docker-admin.yml --repo alin155/mixlab --ref admin-docker-candidate-9c015b9105e97954240020781f79daae3f954bde -f push_images=true -f current_image_tag=latest -f rollback_image_tag=latest

gates.title: Image push proof is local and read-only
gates.evidence: Reads archived GitHub run, artifact readiness, release inputs, and push decision reports only; it does not contact GitHub, GHCR, NAS, Docker, Admin API, Cutter API, or Windows Runner.

gates.title: Source reports do not approve push or deploy by themselves
gates.evidence: run.deploy=false, readiness.deploy=false, release_inputs.push=false, release_inputs.deploy=false, push_package.push=false, push_package.deploy=false
gates.required_evidence: All source reports must remain evidence only: push_execution_allowed=false and docker_deploy_allowed=false.

gates.title: Release inputs are ready
gates.required_evidence: Use an accepted admin-docker-release-inputs report before proving a pushed target image.

gates.title: Push decision package was ready before push
gates.required_evidence: Prepare the push decision package before running workflow_dispatch with push_images=true.

gates.title: Workflow dispatch command is exact and placeholder-free
gates.required_evidence: Release inputs and push decision package must agree on the exact docker-admin workflow_dispatch command.

gates.title: GitHub Admin Docker workflow completed successfully
gates.required_evidence: Collect a successful workflow_dispatch run artifact after running push_images=true.

gates.title: GitHub run was manually dispatched
gates.required_evidence: The image push proof must come from workflow_dispatch, not an automatic push run.

gates.title: GitHub run target matches release inputs target tag
gates.required_evidence: Run the workflow on the admin-docker-candidate tag that points at the target image SHA.

gates.title: GitHub artifact still proves the Docker candidate
gates.required_evidence: The same run must still produce accepted Admin Docker candidate smoke evidence.

gates.title: Artifact records workflow_dispatch push_images=true
gates.required_evidence: The GitHub artifact readiness report must observe image_push_approval_accepted=true, which the workflow sets only when push_images=true.

gates.title: Artifact no longer carries image push blocker
gates.required_evidence: After push_images=true, artifact readiness staging blockers must not include image-push-explicitly-approved.

result.summary: Image push proof is blocked until a successful workflow_dispatch push_images=true run is archived and matched to release inputs.

next_actions: Resolve image push proof blockers: image-push-approval-observed-in-artifact, image-push-blocker-cleared-from-artifact.
Keep staging execution blocked until a successful push_images=true workflow run is archived and this proof is accepted.
